description: In the divisibility order on the divisors of 12, both members of {4,6} are minimal and maximal in that subset, but it has no least or greatest element.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor_pair_extrema :
  (∀ x ∈ {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯},
      Minimal (fun x => x ∈ {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯}) x ∧
        Maximal (fun x => x ∈ {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯}) x) ∧
    (¬∃ x, IsLeast {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯} x) ∧
      ¬∃ x, IsGreatest {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯} x
